name: basal-omni-1.0-ultra
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-31B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 4)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of google/gemma-4-31B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 31.273 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-15. CAVEATS: the winning row is the author's own 160-item Polish probe (omni-probe-pl), not a public benchmark; the image column is scored zero-shot because the image encoder was never trained - the model loses the sibling photo row (0.800 vs untrained base 0.833) and the card itself says the 3.3-point photo gap is within noise. Trained on ~640k Polish/English typed decisions distilled from basal-1.5. Experimental release.

benchmarks.name: omni-probe-pl: decision from image of rendered document
benchmarks.config: Card omni-probe-pl table, 160 items answered from the image; same table's 'untrained Gemma 4 31B, from the image' column 0.769. Photo row loses (0.800 vs 0.833).
